finsights.brief: Has raised its dividend for 3 consecutive years
Stock generally trades with low price volatility

summary: ADNOC Logistics posted record Q2 2026 results: $2.6B revenue, $1.1B EBITDA, $951M net profit; raised FY guidance for third time this year.
FY 2026 outlook upgraded to mid-20% revenue growth, mid-60% EBITDA growth, and high 110% net profit growth versus 2025 levels.
Shipping segment drove earnings on elevated tanker rates; 19 of 50 planned vessels delivered under $5.7B capex program through 2029.
Geopolitical risks persist after Strait of Hormuz attacks damaged two VLCCs, causing casualties and 6-8 month repair timelines.
Management maintaining dividend policy despite strong quarter, prioritizing capital deployment into ADNOC-backed growth opportunities.
